Release v0.6.0 · All files and checksums · Every release is signed: SHA256SUMS comes with a minisign signature.

After installing

  1. Open PhoeCord from the Start menu, Launchpad or your app menu.
  2. Pick the Discord you use and press Install PhoeCord. Your system may ask you to confirm the local certificate.
  3. Open Discord from PhoeCord (or its new shortcut) and turn plugins on in Settings.

Prefer the terminal?

The release also has a plain CLI archive for every system. Or build from source:

git clone https://github.com/Nanda070/phoecord
cd phoecord
cargo run --release -- setup

Removing it

Uninstall from Installed apps (Windows), or run phoecord uninstall. Both remove the certificate, the shortcuts and every file PhoeCord added.

phoecord uninstall
